about: Every artwork, screenshot, icon, font, dataset and media file RipTide ships or keeps in the repository. docs/legal/ASSET_REGISTER.md explains it; a test fails if a tracked file isn't covered by exactly one entry. Not legal advice.

reviewed.by: Prepared from the repository for the owner; not reviewed by counsel

assets.title: Leonida map art (raster tiles, zoom 0 to 4)
assets.owner: Rockstar Games / Take-Two Interactive (artwork); tiles prepared by gtadb.org
assets.source: https://github.com/rolux/gtadb.org (maps/tiles/6/day/0-4), from the map Rockstar released as a free download on 2026-11-19
assets.revision: d406fea099e1df2bce42fd6b87eed04bce646629 (2026-11-19); sha256 of the 2,011 tile files in sorted order: c54d8030e011c9241493b9d181de3992041e4e959c08ef259fb3e17853007c9a
assets.licenseNote: No licence from Rockstar or Take-Two is on record. gtadb.org's CC BY 4.0 covers gtadb.org's own contribution, not Rockstar's rights in the artwork.
assets.obligations: Credit 'Map of Leonida © Rockstar Games. Tiles prepared by gtadb.org.' wherever the art is shown.
assets.removal: Set the repository variable RIPTIDE_MAP_ART=off, publish a new desktop release, delete the art from earlier release assets, let Pages redeploy, replace the promotional media marked mapArt. Deleting files from Git doesn't retract downloads, caches or history.

assets.title: Place data (GTA VI Landmarks Data)
assets.licenseNote: Names of fictional places come from the game. Real-world venue names are kept only as 'inspired by' references; addresses and private homes are removed.
assets.obligations: Credit gtadb.org and contributors, link the licence, say what RipTide changed. Done in the map, Help > About and credits, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
assets.rightsEvidence: gtadb.org LICENSE-DATA (CC BY 4.0) and readme inviting reuse with attribution.
assets.removal: Replace or empty places.json and rebuild; player progress is keyed by place id and survives.

assets.title: Screenshots and trailer that show the map art
assets.owner: Dosuka (RipTide UI); contains Rockstar's map art
assets.source: Captured from RipTide (scripts/video/capture-tools.mjs, scripts/video/tools-trailer.mjs). The trailer has no audio track.
assets.licenseNote: Same rights question as the map art, plus promotional use, which Rockstar's policy doesn't cover by default.
assets.obligations: Credit the map art where shown.
assets.removal: Re-capture with the schematic grid (Settings > Map background) and replace these files; update README and site/index.html references.

assets.title: Screenshots of RipTide without game art
assets.licenseNote: Shows game titles as plain text (e.g. Grand Theft Auto V) and fictional place names in sample data. No game art.

assets.title: Design mockups (v2)
assets.source: Design handoff for the Tools shell
assets.licenseNote: The map mockup uses an abstract placeholder, not the map art.

assets.title: RipTide logo, mark, wordmark and app icons
assets.source: Original. The wordmark is outlined from TeX Gyre Adventor Bold (scripts/wordmark.py), which the GUST Font License permits.
assets.licenseNote: Not derived from any game logo or artwork (brand/BRAND.md).
assets.obligations: Keep RipTide's identity separate from Rockstar's: no game logos as app identity.

assets.title: DM Sans
assets.obligations: Ship the copyright notice and licence with the font: in the font metadata and in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt next to the app.
assets.rightsEvidence: Licence in the font's name table.

assets.title: Anonymous Pro
assets.source: Mark Simonson Studio (http://www.ms-studio.com, as named in the font's licence)
assets.licenseNote: Unmodified. Reserved Font Name: Anonymous Pro.
assets.obligations: Ship the notice and licence (font metadata, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt). Don't modify it under the same name.
assets.rightsEvidence: Full licence in the font's name table.

assets.title: TeX Gyre Adventor Bold
assets.owner: B. Jackowski, J.M. Nowacki et al. (on behalf of TeX Users Groups)
assets.licenseNote: GUST Font License, an instance of the LPPL 1.3c. One file of the TeX Gyre Adventor package is shipped, renamed but unmodified. Counsel may want to confirm LPPL wording on shipping part of a package (common practice for web fonts).
assets.obligations: Ship the copyright notice and licence (THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt).
assets.removal: Replace the font file and regenerate the wordmark only if the brand changes.

bundledCode: npm packages bundled into the app are found from esbuild's metafile and checked against an allowlist on every build (scripts/licenses.mjs); their licences ship as THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. The desktop app's Electron and electron-updater licences ship with the app (vendor/electron-updater.LICENSES.txt and Electron's own files).
